source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: ("urban flooding" OR "urban floods") AND (governance OR vulnerability OR politics)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:("urban flooding" OR "urban floods") AND (governance OR vulnerability OR politics),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("urban flooding" OR "urban floods") AND ("governance" OR "politics" OR "vulnerability"))
